answer: A payout is split which means 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The raven schedule is applied in crystal and terrace shows each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 510 identities would post 4457 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
